verdict.rationale: Exporting data in open formats is a fair question for a memory engine, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export command or format. Open-source local operation, deletion via forget, uploading to Cloud via push, and a descriptive Graph Insight Report are adjacent features, not a documented export of all data in open formats. The RDF/OWL support covers ontology input only, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
